name: General Self-Efficacy Scale
instructions: Please indicate your level of agreement with each of the following statements.

items.text: I can always manage to solve difficult problems if I try hard enough.
items.help: Please indicate your level of agreement with each of the following statements.

items.text: If someone opposes me, I can find the means and ways to get what I want.
items.help: Please indicate your level of agreement with each of the following statements.

items.text: It is easy for me to stick to my aims and accomplish my goals.
items.help: Please indicate your level of agreement with each of the following statements.

items.text: I am confident that I could deal efficiently with unexpected events.
items.help: Please indicate your level of agreement with each of the following statements.

items.text: Thanks to my resourcefulness, I know how to handle unforeseen situations.
items.help: Please indicate your level of agreement with each of the following statements.

items.text: I can solve most problems if I invest the necessary effort.
items.help: Please indicate your level of agreement with each of the following statements.

items.text: I can remain calm when facing difficulties because I can rely on my coping abilities.
items.help: Please indicate your level of agreement with each of the following statements.

items.text: When I am confronted with a problem, I can usually find several solutions.
items.help: Please indicate your level of agreement with each of the following statements.

items.text: If I am in trouble, I can usually think of a solution.
items.help: Please indicate your level of agreement with each of the following statements.

items.text: I can usually handle whatever comes my way.
items.help: Please indicate your level of agreement with each of the following statements.

notes: Use original author’s English items, replacing paraphrases in the OpenScales English table. Sum all ten 1–4 responses.
No missing-value imputation. Source report templates, guessed norm thresholds and generated text are not used.
